Stores are topped up by transfer from th: Stores get stock from the warehouse. The warehouse orders from suppliers to meet the stores' needs. Review and approve each suggestion before placing an order.

Count what actually arrived. Enter 0 if: Count the goods that arrived. Enter 0 for missing items. Record damaged items and expiry dates. Any difference creates a problem to follow up. Then mark the order as received in StoreHub to update stock.
Count what is physically there and type: Count the items and enter the quantity. Enter 0 if there are none. When you save, the system checks the latest StoreHub stock.

StoreHub has no expiry dates, so they ar: Add expiry dates when receiving goods or checking shelves. You get reminders 30, 14, 7 and 3 days before expiry. Only items added here are tracked.
Permits, certificates and equipment serv: Keep permit expiry dates and equipment service dates here. You get reminders 30, 14 and 7 days before the due date, and when overdue.

Repeat imports do not duplicate transfer: Uploading the same transfer again will not add a duplicate. Older statuses are ignored. Upload the latest export to see StoreHub changes.
